headline: Approved three school staff appointments, including Sarah Kulig as Greene-Hills School principal.
summary: The board approved three staff appointments: Sarah Kulig as principal of Greene-Hills School, Julie Barbash as assistant principal of Chippens Hill Middle School, and Shannon Gomez as Dean of Pupil Personnel Services. Superintendent Iris White recommended each candidate.
decisions: Approved the appointment of Sarah Kulig as Principal of Greene-Hills School, passed 5-0.
Approved the appointment of Julie Barbash as Assistant Principal of Chippens Hill Middle School, passed 5-0.
Approved the appointment of Shannon Gomez as Dean of Pupil Personnel Services, passed 6-0.

decision_evidence.quote: Commissioner Parenti motioned to approve the appointment of Sara Kulig as Principal of Greene-Hills School... Motion made by Kara Ledger and second by Barbara Tedesco. Motion passed 5-0.

Commissioner Parenti motioned to approve the appointment of Julie Barbash as Assistant Principal of Chippens Hill Middle School... Motion made by Kara Ledger and second by Barbara Tedesco. Motion passed 5-0.
Commissioner Parenti motioned to approve the appointment of Shannon Gomez as Dean of Pupil Personnel Services... Motion made by Kara Ledger and second by Jill Fitzsimons-Bula. Motion passed 6-0.
